svg.title: Time to first token in chat
svg.desc: MacBook Air M4 · 16 GiB · core medians · lower is faster. Both panels have the same zero-based linear scale; lower is faster. Internal TTFT excludes loading, tokenization and terminal transport. Default horizon row is Guffin H1 versus llama.cpp H3; final row matches H1 with other defaults unchanged. 32 observations per median · same linear scale from zero · follow-up histories can differ. Values in seconds: {"First replies": {"gemma2-release-v2": {"guffin": 0.4089245, "llama": 0.653895}, "gemma3-normal-release-v2": {"guffin": 0.6124545, "llama": 0.80305}, "gemma3-speculative-release": {"guffin": 0.612609, "llama": 0.807725}, "gemma3-h1-vs-h1": {"guffin": 0.612923, "llama": 0.811005}}, "Follow-ups": {"gemma2-release-v2": {"guffin": 0.2550725, "llama": 2.528645}, "gemma3-normal-release-v2": {"guffin": 0.4525645, "llama": 1.307855}, "gemma3-speculative-release": {"guffin": 0.4551535, "llama": 1.30331}, "gemma3-h1-vs-h1": {"guffin": 0.4538695, "llama": 1.303575}}}
